items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Venuti, Hackett, Zoot. I stayed around with Zoot for a while. I worked with Zoot in New York. I worked with Zoot up until right before he died and did a couple of recordings with him. Jimmy Rowles.

ctx.x: Well when I look at the list of other people you’ve been with, unfortunately most of them are gone.

My fault — I killed them all. It’s really awful. It’s kind of embarrassing. Well they were all going to live forever if it weren’t for me, right. But what the truth of the matter is is I was lucky enough and I was very young and these were some very old people and I got in on the tail end of some really great careers. Venuti, Hackett, Zoot. I stayed around with Zoot for a while. I worked with Zoot in New York. I worked with Zoot up until right before he died and did a couple of recordings with him. Jimmy Rowles.…
